reviews.text: Great way to kickstart your own home orchard. Kalan grew up in the business and is a knowledgeable and hard worker. Outstanding experience!
reviews.author: Roland F.

reviews.text: We are so excited to watch our orchard grow! Kalan from Home Orchards was very enjoyable to work with. We learned so much already and look forward to working with him through the next year as the trees become established.
reviews.author: Michelle Z.

reviews.text: Home Orchard is the best, period. They're dedicated, they're experts in local crops, and they're very approachable for a novice. Home Orchard helped with the entire process, and taught us along the way! Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Josh B.
